guideStep1Title: Create a project just for this app
guideStep1Body: Don't reuse a project from something else: the name shown at sign-in and the access rules apply to everything that uses the project. To get an **Internal** audience, create it signed in with the company account, inside its organization; a personal project only offers External.
guideStep2Title: Enable the Google Chat API and configure the Chat app
guideStep2Body: After enabling it, open the API's **Configuration** tab and fill in the name, an icon URL and a description. You don't need any interactive features. Without this configuration conversations open, but sending fails with "Google Chat app not found".
guideStep3Title: Set up the Google Auth Platform
guideBranding: **Branding:** the name shown on the sign-in screen, such as "Google Chat Client", and your email.
guideAudience: **Audience:** **Internal** only accepts accounts from the organization that owns the project, with no test list. **External** accepts accounts from any company.
guideDataAccess: **Data access:** add the scopes below. You can paste the list into "Manually add scopes".
guideStep4Title: With an External audience: testing or production
guideTesting: **In testing**, only people listed under Audience > Test users can sign in. An account outside the list sees "has not completed the Google verification process (...) can only be accessed by developer-approved testers". The session expires every 7 days and the account has to be added again.
guideProduction: **In production** (Audience > Publish app), the session doesn't expire every week. Without verification, sign-in shows the unverified app screen, and the project accepts up to 100 users over its whole life. Google's documentation says a restricted scope, like `chat.messages`, needs verification in production; if sign-in is blocked, go back to testing.
guideStep5Title: Create the client and import it here
guideStep5Body: Under **Clients**, create a client of type **Desktop app**, download the JSON and use **Import JSON file** in settings. Then add the account. To sign in from another browser or container, use **Copy link** while sign-in is pending.
guideStep6Title: If a company blocks the app
guideStep6Body: The administrator block error means that Workspace restricts third-party apps. Its admin allows the client ID in Admin console > Security > Access and data control > API controls, marking the app as **Trusted**.
